title: A Orchard for the Atlas
author: Isandro Vasquez
blurb: Lior Ravensworth, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
